title: The **Prime-Embedded Quantum Squeezed State Algorithm (PEQSSA)** incorporates **prime-number encoding** into the generation and manipulation of **quantum squeezed states**. **Squeezed states** are quantum states where the uncertainty (quantum noise) in one quadrature is reduced (squeezed) below the vacuum state level, at the cost of increased uncertainty in the conjugate quadrature. These states are critical for applications in **quantum metrology**, **quantum communication**, and **quantum optics**, particularly for enhancing the precision of measurements and improving the sensitivity of quantum systems.
